author: Rich Harang
content:
AI-powered applications are introducing new attack surfaces that traditional security models don’t fully capture, especially as these agentic systems gain...

AI-powered applications are introducing new attack surfaces that traditional security models don’t fully capture, especially as these agentic systems gain autonomy. The guiding principle for the evolving attack surface is clear: Assume prompt injection. But turning that into effective defenses is rarely straightforward. The Cyber Kill Chain security framework defines how attackers operate.
